description:
Add contributor install and run guidance for the pinned cargo-nextest to the testing guide.

## Background

The pinned executable, committed `.config/nextest.toml` policy, and CI provisioning land in `nextest-foundation`; this task documents them for contributors. The later `inherent-cost-attribution` task adds the cost table to the same file in a declared ordered overlap.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Documents installing the pinned cargo-nextest 0.9.133 with `cargo install cargo-nextest --locked --version 0.9.133` and running the workspace suite and doctest substep in `dev/TESTING.md`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Describes the committed `.config/nextest.toml` policy by citation rather than restating its values.

## Notes

Ordered overlap: `dev/TESTING.md` is touched here first; `inherent-cost-attribution` adds the cost table afterwards.
title: Document pinned nextest installation and use
